item.title: Dua Lipa Makes Surprise Appearance at Tame Impala’s London O2 Show
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. We've got an exciting update for you today. Dua Lipa recently crashed Tame Impala's London show at the O2 Arena, joining Kevin Parker onstage for an unannounced two-song set."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "Lipa appeared mid-set, no introduction needed, and launched into the chorus of their 2025 collaboration 'After Thought'. After that, Parker welcomed her to the stage, and they broke into Lipa's 2024 hit 'Houdini', which Parker produced for her album Radical Optimism."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "This isn't the first time these two artists have shared the stage. They've had a series of mutual stage invasions, including at Glastonbury Festival and Lipa's Radical Optimism tour in Australia. The pair first started working together in mid-2022, and it's clear their collaboration has been a success. 'Houdini' peaked at number 5 on the Billboard Hot 100, and Radical Optimism debuted at number 2 on the Billboard 200, earning Lipa a Grammy nomination."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Tame Impala is currently on tour in support of their album The Slow Rush, and we can't wait to see what's next for these two talented artists. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard."
